hero.sub: Killio App is the native app for Windows, macOS, Linux and Android: it opens the Killio of the server you choose and adds what a browser tab cannot do.
hero.ios: Killio App is not available for iPhone or iPad yet. Meanwhile, Killio works in your browser.
hero.noInfo: We could not check the latest build right now. If a download does not start, try again in a few minutes.

platforms.title: One app, four systems
platforms.sub: Every link below always serves the latest build.

windows.desc: Installer (.exe). An .msi package is also available.
windows.note: Not code-signed yet: Windows will warn the first time you open it.

macos.desc: One universal .dmg for Apple silicon and Intel Macs.
macos.note: Not code-signed yet: macOS will warn the first time you open it.

linux.desc: AppImage for any distribution, or a .deb / .rpm package.
linux.note: Pick the format your distribution uses.

android.desc: APK to install directly on your phone or tablet.
android.note: Preview build, not signed for release: it is not on an app store, and Android may warn about or block the install.

signing.title: Before you install
signing.body: Killio App is new. The Windows and macOS builds are not code-signed yet, so the system shows a warning the first time you open them, and the Android build is a preview that is not signed for release. Download it only from this page.

servers.title: Server picker
servers.desc: Open killio.dev or your organization's own Killio server.

accounts.title: Several accounts at once
accounts.desc: Keep accounts from different servers signed in and switch between them.

window.title: Its own window
window.desc: A frameless window with its own title bar, with no browser around it.

screenshots.title: Screenshots
screenshots.desc: Take a screenshot from the app and use it where you would attach an image.

signin.title: Sign in with your provider
signin.desc: Google, Microsoft or Bloomx sign-in opens in your system browser.

tools.title: Tools on each device
tools.desc: The agent can open installed apps, system settings and links, set up per device.

offline.title: Works offline
offline.desc: Without a connection it keeps working with what was already loaded.

connect.title: You choose the server
connect.body: Killio App is a window onto a Killio server: it opens the Killio of the server you pick, and you can keep accounts from several servers.
connect.cloudDesc: The Killio cloud. Sign in with the account you already use on the web.
connect.ownDesc: If your organization runs its own Killio, enter the address it gave you.

mobile.title: Killio App
mobile.description: The native app for Android, Windows, macOS and Linux. Open killio.dev or your organization's server in its own window.
